title: docs(changeset): date-note two pending entries whose option-description and rows refusals spec 17.3.0 lifted (objectui#10801)
body:
Fixes #10801
Clause-②: no

## What this does

Two pending changesets still tell a reader that `@objectstack/spec` refuses `options[].description` and `rows` by name. Spec 17.3.0 declared both keys (the objectui#6140 / objectui#6153 ruling), and this repository installs 17.4.0. A pending changeset publishes verbatim into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so the text would ship stating the opposite of the installed contract.

Each file gains ONE appended dated note in the objectui#10533 form: a bold headline naming the date and the card, then what holds now, then a sentence keeping the rest as the reading of the change. The frontmatter is byte-identical (md5 of the frontmatter block, base to head: 6140 `85cd680d`, 7014-q1 `ecedb10c`, both unchanged), and zero lines are deleted (`git diff` is 35 insertions, 0 deletions).

| File | What the note corrects (quoted, not line-addressed) |
| --- | --- |
| `.changeset/6140-field-metadata-rows-option-description.md` | "`FieldSchema` refuses `rows` BY NAME … on all four of textarea/markdown/html/richtext"; "`SelectOptionSchema` is strict over exactly `{label, value, color, default, visibleWhen}` and refuses `description` BY NAME"; "never in an object document sent to the platform" |
| `.changeset/7014-q1-tier1-select-option-convergence.md` | the EXTENSION paragraph's five-key claim, "refuses each of those three by name" and "must never reach an authored object document" for `description`; plus "exactly one key, on one face" and "`SelectOption` identically" |

**Why the 7014-q1 note also corrects "What widened".** It is the same cause in the same file. `SelectOptionBase` derives the spec's option keys by reference, so when 17.3.0 added `description` the SDUI form face `SelectOption` gained an optional `description` too. The entry's "exactly one key, on one face" and "`SelectOption` identically" therefore undercount what ships. Nothing narrowed. The note says so in the same paragraph, and no other sentence was touched.

**Placement.** The claim's file surface says "appended", so both notes sit at the end of their files. In 6140 that puts the note directly after the existing 17.2.0 correction paragraph, which reads as a chronological chain. The objectui#10533 precedent (`6235-mergedsort-wrap.md`) put its note after the opening paragraph; only the form is copied here, not the position.

## Measured, not inherited

`@objectstack/spec` was resolved from `packages/types` in this worktree: 17.4.0, and `pnpm-lock.yaml` has exactly one entry, 17.4.0. To date the move, 17.2.0 and 17.3.0 were installed from the registry into a scratch directory. Every probe sits beside a control that differs only by the key. Option values are at least two characters long: a one-character value fails `too_small` at `value` for an unrelated reason. The first run hit that failure and was discarded.

| Probe | 17.2.0 | 17.3.0 | 17.4.0 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SelectOptionSchema` keys | color, default, label, value, visibleWhen | + description | + description (catchall `never`, i.e. strict) |
| option with `description` | `unrecognized_keys` | accepted | accepted |
| select `FieldSchema` / `ObjectSchema` whose option carries `description` | `unrecognized_keys` at the option | accepted | accepted |
| option with `icon` (the lit control) | `unrecognized_keys` | `unrecognized_keys` | `unrecognized_keys` |
| option with `disabled` | `unrecognized_keys` | `unrecognized_keys` | `unrecognized_keys` |
| `rows: 4` on textarea, markdown, html, richtext | `unrecognized_keys` | accepted | accepted |
| `rows: 4` on `text` | `unrecognized_keys` | `custom` at `rows` | `custom` at `rows` |
| `rows: 4` on every `FieldType` member | not probed | not probed | 4 accept (the four above); the other 45 each add exactly one issue, `custom` at `rows` |

A note on the triage reading: triage named `textarea` and `markdown` as accepting `rows`. The installed spec accepts it on all four multiline editor types, and the notes say four.

Form face, by type probe on the worktree sources at 17.4.0: `keyof SelectOption` equals `label | value | color | default | description | visibleWhen | disabled | icon`, and a negative control asserting the seven keys without `description` fails with TS2344. The convergence pin's own assertions compile (`assertionFormFaceGainedOnlyDescription`, `assertionFormFaceKeptEveryMember`, `assertionMetadataFaceKeptEveryMember`, `assertionMetadataFaceGainedOnlyDefault`). `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both pin files, so the package `type-check` re-derives them.

Still pending: distinctive strings from both bodies (for example "refuses `rows` BY NAME", "The convergence is an EXTENSION", "consumed-but-undeclared field-metadata keys") have 0 hits across all 42 tracked `CHANGELOG.md` files. The lit control, the released entry "Adopt `@objectstack/spec`", hits `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md`.

The notes name the instruments that re-derive these facts instead of copying the answers: `select-option-spec-extension-7014.test.ts` covers the option key set, `description` accepted, `icon` / `disabled` refused, `rows` accepted on the four types, and `custom` on `text` / `select`. `select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts` covers the form face's gained key.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation, not carded, owner: none. The `SelectOptionBase` docblock in `packages/types/src/select-option.ts` lists "WHAT COMES FROM THE SPEC, unchanged" as `label`, `value`, `color`, `default`. `description` also arrives from the spec by reference now. The list is incomplete, not false: nothing there says `description` is refused. The same docblock deliberately declines to re-enumerate the keys, so this is polish.
- Scanned the other pending changesets, line-joined, for the same refusal claim about `description` or `rows`. The only other carrier is the sibling `7014-select-option-spec-claim-correction.md`, which already carries its correction.
